newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit retains gains, seen at 2.5050/dlr soon.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit retains gains, seen at 2.5050/dlr soon.

text.p: The ringgit retained its early gains and was expected to rise further, but within its recent trading range, over the next few days, dealers said.
They said the market was shedding its long dollar positions created by last week's sell off in the ringgit.
"Expected weakening of the Singapore dollar should also help the ringgit," a dealer with a Malaysian bank said.
"At 1.78 (per Singapore dollar level) you cannot really go wrong in moving back to ringgit," he added.
Many investors had been selling off the ringgit against the Singapore dollar in the last few weeks.
